p: days: Long life is the blessing of God which he gives to his, so far as it is expedient for them.
mercy and truth forsake thee: By mercy and truth he means the commandments of the first and second table, or else the mercy and faithfulness that we ought to use toward our neighbours.
neck: Keep them as a precious jewel.
heart: Have them ever in remembrance.
navel: By this part he comprehends the whole body, as by health he means all the benefits promised in the law both corporal and spiritual.

Honour the LORD with thy substance: As was commanded in the law, Ex 23:19, De 26:2 and by this they acknowledged that God was the giver of all things, and that they were ready to bestow all at his commandment.
burst out with new wine: For the faithful distributor God gives in greater abundance.
and in her left hand riches: Meaning, that he seeks wisdom, that is, suffers himself to be governed by the Word of God, will have all prosperity both corporal and spiritual.
of life to them that lay: Which brings forth such fruit that they who eat of it have life and he alludes to the tree of life in paradise.
founded the earth: By this he shows that this wisdom of which he speaks is everlasting, because it was before all creatures and that all things even the whole world were made by it.
Be not afraid of sudden fear: For when God destroys the wicked he will save his as he did Lot in Sodom.
them to whom it is due: Not only from them to whom the possession belongs but also you shall not keep it from them who have need of the use of it.
securely by thee: That is, puts his trust in you.
Envy thou not the oppressor: Do not wish to be like him.
secret is with the righteous: That is, his covenant and fatherly affection which is hid and secret from the world.
he scorneth the scorners: He will show by his plagues that their scorn will turn to their own destruction, Pr 1:26.
